Let me analyze this ticket.

Keith Mclaughlin (E032) requests write access to Source Code.

Facts:
- Role: Analyst
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (from Security agent, looked up in own database)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

The employee has basic security training, not advanced. So the maximum level is read.

Requested level: write. Requested level is above maximum, so grant the maximum: read.

Both agents recommend read.

Decision: read.
